business_meaning: Surrogate key that uniquely identifies the savings account row in the dimension.
inferred_rules: Unique; non-null; stable surrogate (never reused); primary key for the table.

business_meaning: Bank-assigned account number that identifies the customer savings account.
inferred_rules: Should be unique per active account; non-null for active records; used as the natural/business key for identifying accounts.

business_meaning: Identifier for the customer who owns the savings account.
inferred_rules: Non-null for customer-linked accounts; should reference a customer master key outside this table; format constrained by source system.

business_meaning: Code indicating the savings product type or offering for the account.
inferred_rules: Must match a valid product in product master; non-null when product is assigned; values constrained to product code dictionary.

business_meaning: Current lifecycle status of the account.
inferred_rules: Value must be one of the allowed statuses; if AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' then AccountCloseDate should be non-null; 'OPEN' implies AccountCloseDate is null.

business_meaning: Currency code used for the account balances.
inferred_rules: Should follow a standard currency code list (e.g., ISO 4217); non-null for accounts holding balances; consistent across related monetary fields.

business_meaning: Date the account was opened in the source system.
inferred_rules: Non-null; must be <= today; must be <= AccountCloseDate when AccountCloseDate is present; must be <= AccountMaturityDate when MaturityDate is present.

business_meaning: Maturity date for term savings accounts, if applicable.
inferred_rules: Nullable for non-term accounts; when present must be >= AccountOpenDate; must be >= today only if future maturity allowed (otherwise may be past).

business_meaning: Date the account was closed, if it has been closed.
inferred_rules: Nullable for active accounts; when present must be >= AccountOpenDate; if AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' then should be non-null; should not be in the future.

business_meaning: Date/time when this dimension row version became effective.
inferred_rules: Non-null; used for SCD versioning; ValidFrom <= ValidTo; typically set at load time; if IsCurrent = 1 then ValidTo may be NULL or a high-date.

business_meaning: Date/time when this dimension row version ceased to be effective.
inferred_rules: Non-null (or use a sentinel high-date) for closed SCD rows; ValidTo >= ValidFrom; if IsCurrent = 1 then ValidTo should be a high-date or sentinel value.

business_meaning: Indicator whether this row is the current active version for the account.
inferred_rules: Value 1 indicates the current row; only one row per business key (AccountNumber) should have IsCurrent = 1 at any time; IsCurrent is complementary to ValidFrom/ValidTo.
